metadata.description: The Astound Digital workspace: everyday development skills (debugging, commits, code review) for every signed-in user, and the admin control plane (activity and user reports, CLI reference, and the systemprompt MCP server) for admins. The knowledge bank, Atlassian and Salesforce connectors and the full skill suite are work in progress — preserved on the backup/full-marketplace-and-skills branch.

plugins.name: astound-admin
plugins.description: Admin-only control plane for Claude Code: who is using the platform, what it did, and how to drive the systemprompt CLI. Ships the systemprompt MCP server plus the activity report, user report, and CLI reference skills.

plugins.name: astound-dev
plugins.description: Self-contained development skills for every signed-in user of Claude Code: root-cause debugging before any fix, a gated branch-commit-PR workflow, and a senior-reviewer code review. No MCP server and no credentials required.
